label: 12-inch at 33 1/3 rpm
note: Gotta Groove: 18 ideal, 20 still good, issues may start at 22. RPM Records (2023) says definition drops above about 20; quiet material can reach 25-27 per one engineer.

label: 12-inch at 45 rpm
note: Gotta Groove: 12 ideal, 14 ok, call first beyond 15. RPM Records (2023) also gives up to 15.

label: 7-inch at 45 rpm
note: Gotta Groove gives one figure, so comfortable is set equal to max. RPM Records (2023) allows up to 5.

label: 7-inch at 33 1/3 rpm
note: Gotta Groove gives one figure, so comfortable is set equal to max; it prefers 45 when the side allows. RPM Records does not recommend 7-inch at 33.
